title: Thinking, Fast and Slow
author: Daniel Kahneman
excerpt: A foundational read on how we actually make decisions — and how often our intuition misleads us.

body: The best dashboards answer a question before you finish asking it. If someone has to *study* your chart, it's a diagram, not a decision aid.
Oaks grow slowly and that's the point. Compound interest works on knowledge too — a page a day is a library in a decade. 🌳
